summary: Rewrites the printed tree's generated-file header to the canonical Go marker and handles every previously-swallowed error in the hand-written Y.js, Socket.IO and canvas-write packages.
reason: Line 2 of every printed file read '// Generated by CLI Printing Press (...). DO NOT EDIT.', which does not match Go's canonical '// Code generated ... DO NOT EDIT.' marker, so no Go tool recognised the tree as generated. golangci-lint therefore reported 290 findings against machine-authored code that AGENTS.md forbids hand-editing. Renaming the header to the canonical form is the systemic fix and belongs upstream in the Printing Press header template; until it lands there, a reprint would silently reintroduce the whole backlog. The error-handling changes are hand-written-package fixes: unchecked goja vm.Set/RunString in internal/yjs could let a script run against a stale doc handle and mutate the wrong AFFiNE document, and unchecked socket.io Emit/On could drop a canvas write without surfacing anything.
validated_outcome: go build ./cmd/..., go test ./... (287 passing, unchanged), and golangci-lint v2.11.4 run against an LF copy of the tree report 0 issues (down from 319).
